These handwraps can be customized to shine in any color in the visible spectrum when used, and some manufacturers offer custom firmware that modifies their appearance to manifest as a claw, oversized fist, or hammerhead. They can even be worn in alternate ways on other parts of the body. These handwraps enhance your unarmed attacks as if they were manufactured weapons, allowing you to add an upgrade to your unarmed attacks. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons in the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes.

Your unarmed attacks gain the tracking +2 trait and increase the damage to three dice.

Q65y4LVV2DAf8Hef.name: 终极型衰退手雷
Q65y4LVV2DAf8Hef.description:

Degradation grenades create violent blasts of magic that rip matter into different realities, leaving behind blackened hunks of matter that dissipate into nothingness. When the grenade explodes, it deals 12d8 acid damage in a @Template[burst|distance:20] with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

QCzqkk6x05wG7qWV.name: 调声系统
QCzqkk6x05wG7qWV.description: 一系列微型促动器与动态超共鸣腔重塑了你的喉部。调声系统可让你改变声音的音高、音色与音调，因此你可以模仿口音或发出外星语言的音。当你使用欺骗来进行乔装时，若你的声音能够完善你的伪装的话（由GM定夺），你在该检定上获得+1物品加值。

QGV4NiKDCHYOK5Dj.name: 大艾巴萨罗姆接力赛奖章
QGV4NiKDCHYOK5Dj.description: 此奖章代表着你是大艾巴萨罗姆接力赛的胜者，内置的数据驱动完整收录了赛事直播录像。穿戴此奖章时，赛事粉丝会认出你并更愿意提供协助。你在与艾巴萨罗姆空间站的居民交流时进行的交涉检定上获得+1物品加值。

Qgvp7Hiq1MkibzTW.name: 卓越型声波手雷
Qgvp7Hiq1MkibzTW.description:
启动 1区域射击

The aural grenade contains a speaker that emits a dissonant, shrill sound that debilitates those closest to it when it triggers.

QuUyXSB0yTCM3bcR.name: 商用型恐惧投射器
QuUyXSB0yTCM3bcR.description: 这种整合型全息投影仪能让此武器造成的伤势看上去比实际更为严重。当你用此武器重击时，目标陷入@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{惊惧 Frightened 1}。

R8dEureCA93msBsa.name: 精英型爆燃手雷

RfYKYFGsjUemREqF.name: 战术型歌姬麦克风
RfYKYFGsjUemREqF.description:
This ostentatious crystal microphone is embellished with glimmering jewels and delicate lights that pulse in time to music. It functions as both a microphone and speaker, amplifying your voice loud enough for you to be heard clearly by all listeners up to 500 feet away, even if other ambient noise would otherwise block the sound. This doesn't increase the range or area of other auditory or linguistic effects, and physical barriers such as walls still block or muffle your voice as normal.

The diva's microphone grants a +2 item bonus to Performance checks attempted with it.

Activate—Grand Finale 2 (auditory)

频率每10分钟一次

Effect Your song reaches an eardrum-bursting climax as you cast a 4th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.spells.Item.QpP30fcEl4NGjHwo] originating from your space (DC 27).

RlU8twwDgwwqwZ5J.name: 商用型马拉塔头痛
RlU8twwDgwwqwZ5J.description:

Maratan headaches are made from brittle hollow gourds filled with a putrid sludge, dealing 1d8 nonlethal poison damage in a @Template[burst|distance:5] with a @Check[fortitude|against:class|basic] save.

Rp1VEcYu5FLGYvv5.name: 卓越型内爆手雷
Rp1VEcYu5FLGYvv5.description:

Implosion grenades harness a small piece of the Devourer's power to create an implosion that leaves bloody wounds. When the grenade explodes, it deals 8d8 bludgeoning damage in a @Template[type:burst|distance:15] with @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save.

S12VloOQmRvzHN4D.name: 全息星火
S12VloOQmRvzHN4D.description: 这款微型的全息投影仪通常伪装成耳环，襟章或是挂饰。其可存储个性化虚像的简单视觉投影（如光环或翅膀），伴随着短暂的音频（如流行乐曲的片段或是音效）。你的全息星火可以被计算机编程，例如你的通讯单元。

SFgmhbrinHfYVgKB.name: 先进型硬化泡沫手雷
SFgmhbrinHfYVgKB.description:
启动 1区域射击

A grenade erupts and expands as rapidly hardening foam, restricting the movements of creatures caught in its area with a @Check[reflex|against:class|basic] save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw against hardening foam grenades are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, with your class DC as the escape DC.

The burst radius is @Template[burst|distance:10], and on a failure, the creature is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round.

SHQev0CcPaZJmJQW.name: 跃迁弹球
SHQev0CcPaZJmJQW.description:
艾洛娃（Elovai）从一个早已毁灭的现实中收集了这颗金属小球和配套的手套，在那里它作为一种交通方式被创造。

Activate—Toss and Catch 2 (teleportation)

Frequency once per day

Effect You throw the ball to an unoccupied space you can see within 60 feet. You are teleported to the ball's location, arriving with the ball in your gloved hand. If this would bring another creature with you—even if you are carrying it in an extradimensional container—the teleportation effect fails.

SYDiwWNqohoedjZC.name: 阳炎胸花
SYDiwWNqohoedjZC.description:
这枚色彩斑斓、散发肉桂香气的胸花，以橙金花朵从圆形花艺中心炽烈绽放；它是拉约克重燃节（Rekindling festival）期间馈赠的迎宾礼。

Frequency once per day

Effect You utilize the solar energy stored in the sunburst garland to rekindle the hope and spirit of those around you. You emanate bright light in a 20-foot emanation for 1 minute (and dim light to a further 20 feet). When you Let the Sun Shine, and at the end of each of your turns for the next minute, you and any allies within 20 feet regain @Damage[1[healing]] Hit Point.

SYQx5Lv36L0yOrrN.name: 相位盾
SYQx5Lv36L0yOrrN.description: 绑在肢体上的相位盾是一种复杂但可靠的科技装置，他们在展开时会投射出保护性的光盾屏障。相位盾半透明且可以着色，拥有可以高度定制的色彩选项和图像投影。许多人会选择名人、爱人或者美景的图像投影，以在山穷水尽之时鼓舞士气。

SYyG6ZKYlLLO6XAU.name: 卓越型虫群酸液移植
SYyG6ZKYlLLO6XAU.description:
这个腺体能让你吐出许多虫群物种武器化的酸液，但并不能保护你免受喷吐物的伤害。

频率每10分钟一次

SoB2prFShd0z31Cp.name: 纳米光学节点
SoB2prFShd0z31Cp.description:
植入枕叶中的纳米碳结晶节点透过极细的光学纤维与你的视神经相连。你可以启动此节点，用X光数据覆盖你的正常视觉。你可以用单动作解除此视觉覆盖，此动作带有专注特征。

Activate—X-Ray Overlay 1 (concentrate)

Effect Your nano-optics node relays collected X-ray data directly to your eyes, overlaying your normal vision. You can see through most materials and walls within 60 feet. Your sight is blocked by 2 feet of wood or plastic, 1 foot of stone, 2 inches of common metal, or any amount of lead or any starmetal, and you can only see in black and white. Due to the distracting amount of visual information, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to Perception checks while the overlay is active.

SzGr78zdpnnrorre.name: 商用型破片手雷

启动 1区域射击

T0E2WL0QBpaUSlNL.description: 这种光滑的盾牌是特工和其他灵活战斗者的最爱。它最常被设计成一块形状紧紧贴合前臂或其他类似的肢体的聚碳酸酯盾板。

T4JV6YG5OwIPh5UL.name: 自适应能量屏障
T4JV6YG5OwIPh5UL.description:
该装置能改变你护甲上绝缘层的化学成分，使其能响应不同类型的能量。

Activate—Adapt r

频率每10分钟一次

Trigger You take acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage

This lasts until you Adapt again or uninstall any adaptive energy shielding or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ]{Energy Shielding} upgrade from the same armor. If you have multiple energy shielding upgrades on this armor, choose one to change when you Adapt.

This grenade was invented by the Eoxian navy, its designs later stolen by the early Corpse Fleet. When it explodes, the grenade rapidly releases calcifying agents which transform living flesh to bone, dealing 3d8 void damage. Living creatures in a @Template[burst|distance:10] must attempt a basic Reflex save. If you have access to the critical specialization effect of grenades, creatures who critically fail their saving throw become clumsy.

TEYH3HhM9vs5hmky.name: 加速术法术安瓿
TEYH3HhM9vs5hmky.description:
在多数世界被称为“法术安瓿”的法术安瓿瓶，是一种即用型魔法注射剂，可赋予使用者特定环阶法术的好处

TgJMTB1ub5Eh4xJO.name: 灭鬼
TgJMTB1ub5Eh4xJO.description: 此强化能让你伤害没有实体存在的生物。灭鬼武器对付虚体生物时尤其有效，因为这类生物大多都特别容易受到灭鬼武器的伤害。虚体生物可以碰触、持握与持用灭鬼武器（有别于大多数实体物品）。

V02hmKhF0g6s6jHA.description:

Eyeswide detectives use this ultimate @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.D4KuxPi9gqFkvZ3h] to subdue unruly perpetrators nonlethally. VYtnxv13EtkyggD4.name: 情绪映色表皮
VYtnxv13EtkyggD4.description: 注入皮肤的魔法纳米机器人会根据你的情绪自动改变肤色。颜色变化是渐进的，通常至少需要30秒才能完全从一种颜色过渡到另一种颜色。安装时可自定义情绪皮肤的颜色与情绪对应关系。该殖装不计入你的植入物上限。

XrEbh1PXWWVp6O7K.name: 商用型自动爪钩
XrEbh1PXWWVp6O7K.description: 你可以以一个交互动作将这个锚定装置固定在一根缆索上。基座将沿缆索自动滑出钳爪，使其可以如绳结一般攀爬。你可以用你的简易武器熟练进行一次远程攻击检定来对抗取决于目标的DC（通常最少是DC20）以投掷自动爪钩使其固定到一个固体表面。这次攻击具有秘密特征。在成功时，你的自动爪钩牢牢固定。但在大失败时，爪钩看似已经固定但实际上会在你攀爬途中脱落。

If you have the critical weapon specialization of grenades, creatures that critically fail their save are additionally @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.e1XGnhKNSQIm5IXg]{Stupefied 1} for 1 minute.

ZYEtDkPBD5Lm6Unj.description:
该殖装强化了你的肌肉与神经系统，大幅提升身体柔韧性与反应速度。你在特技检定上获得+3物品加值。当你获得此殖装时，你的敏捷调整值提升1点，或者其调整值提升至+4，二者取高。

a0Fp2OVatJVuoV0q.name: 卓越型突击公文包

你可以在突击公文包中安装一个@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.ZIIEmh2nAnST6vGk]，并能如同它被安装在护甲上般使用它。如果你在举起盾牌时使用公文包中集成的武器，盾牌将不再被举起，你也不再获得AC加值。

They can even be worn in alternate ways on other parts of the body. These handwraps enhance your unarmed attacks as if they were manufactured weapons, allowing you to add an upgrade to your unarmed attacks. Treat the handwraps as melee weapons in the brawling group with light Bulk for these purposes.

bMgxTWp5PGp30uQ8.name: 先进型数据接口
bMgxTWp5PGp30uQ8.description:
这种电控殖装是一种可编程的数据端口，并与你的身体整合，让你能够存取计算机与数位储存装置。任何手持式计算机都可以直接插入端口，而更大型的系统则通常需要转接线。你不需要透过介面来存取系统，因为它会透过数据接口直接连入你的神经系统。你仍然必须进行任何与操作该装置有关的技能检定，例如用计算机来访问系统。有些封闭系统完全禁止直接访问数据。

You gain a +2 item bonus to Computers checks when accessing a system with an advanced datajack.

btcbYUK4UqgQ699i.name: 化学分析仪

通过尖端手术，你的喉咙深处被植入了一个适配你所属族裔的生理结构的魔法性腺体。当该器官为生体构造时，从以下列表中选择你的殖装伤害类型：强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰或音波。你获得以下启动效果。

fClhrG92Zi4k14Hq.name: 通讯单元
fClhrG92Zi4k14Hq.description:
个人通讯单元是一款集微型编写计算机和蜂窝通讯设备于一体的袖珍设备，可在行星范围内以文本和音频形式与其他通讯单元即时性无线通讯。一款个人通讯单元也集成了计算器，手电筒（在周围发出5尺明亮光照和相邻的5尺昏暗光照），一个可访问任何当地信息圈的浏览器，以及几个包含游戏在内的娱乐选项。

护甲集成型个人通讯单元具备声控功能；你不需要一只空闲手便可以音频形式和其他通讯单元交流并接受回复，但是发送文本，浏览信息圈或使用应用程序仍需占用至少一只手。

长距离通讯单元便携性较低；其包含内置的供能单元来提供必要数额的功率，且依赖激活的漂流信标进行交流。多数定居点都提供这些终端的短期使用服务。

fGrTEBJ59Q58oRvB.name: 卓越型电击棍
fGrTEBJ59Q58oRvB.description:
Upgrades: 2

Eyeswide detectives use this superior @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.D4KuxPi9gqFkvZ3h] to subdue unruly perpetrators nonlethally. The handle gives the wielder a very mild electrical shock each time it's picked up or unsheathed, so agents tend to wear insulated gloves when they think a stun stick might be needed on a case.

Activate—Short, Sharp Shock A

频率每小时一次

Effect The length of the baton becomes wreathed in electrical energy that can temporarily wreak havoc on a creature's motor skills. Make a melee Strike with the stun stick. On a hit, you deal electricity damage instead of bludgeoning damage, and the target must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:28|options:inflicts:stunned|traits:incapacitation] save or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round; this is an incapacitation effect.

fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ.name: 商用型能量屏障
fQxWOthZx2HZUEzZ.description: 这套护甲有经过特殊的绝缘处理，可以抵御特定类型的伤害。你在强酸、寒冷、电击或火焰上获得5点抗力。制造者在制造强化模块时要选择伤害类型。一套护甲可以放置多个能量屏障，但是每个能量屏障提供的抗力类型必须互不相同。

A tactical smuggler's grip is a hybrid item with the extradimensional, magical, and tech traits. You can pull the weapon into an extradimensional space as an Interact action, leaving behind a palm-sized disk and granting you a +4 item bonus to your Stealth check to Conceal the Object. You can't draw the weapon while it's in the extradimensional space, but you can use an Interact action to retrieve it.

fWsawZJ5YGIyHWpa.name: 辐射扫描仪
fWsawZJ5YGIyHWpa.description: 这款手持设备能够检测120尺范围内的辐射。当你和此设备交互时，它会发出不同音调的提示音以指示低，中，高或严重辐射的存在，并在一块简易屏幕上显示辐射的区域。直到你的下个回合开始前，该数据会随着你的移动自动更新。此后，你必须再次和该设备交互来进行另一次扫描。辐射扫描仪无法穿透3尺的泥土或木材，1尺的石头，1寸厚的常见金属，薄铅板或任何力场。辐射扫描仪对辐射的效果免疫。

iayCU2A9X5rIYvsm.description:
这顶不起眼的软呢帽能增强穿戴者的心能力量。如果你拥有有限心灵感应，则位于你有限心灵感应范围内且你能向其发送讯息的生物，在对抗心灵飞镖、@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.sOPJdbmdO9LPj9Ku], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.feats.Item.rv6hhsxfZwI7vfyR]以及@UUID[Compendium.sf2e-anachronism.equipment.Item.DJJ4hlQLN0iTFP9N]{intercepting ears}.

j66fZJrm1nECG3UM.name: 商用型真皮镀层
j66fZJrm1nECG3UM.description: 硬化甲板保护着你的皮肤，帮助你偏转物理打击。带有真皮镀层的肢体可充当盾牌。你能用你的肢体举起盾牌动作，给予你AC上的+1环境加值，直到你的下个回合开始，且不需要手来使用。你可用你的肢体进行盾牌格挡反应。真皮镀层具有硬度5。在你使用盾牌格挡后，你的真皮镀层会损坏，同时纳米机器人将修复耐用型甲板，24小时内无法再次使用。

The circuits can take on some of a wearer's cognitive load, increasing the speed of their thoughts. The multithreaded carcanet makes your reasoning more efficient, granting you a +2 item bonus to Computers checks.
